summary: Blog by-hand/edited posts: render styled Sources cards from typed CITATIONS block
description:
By-hand (createManualDraft, admin-blog.ts:243) and hand-edited blog posts carry the operator's CITATIONS block inside content and have empty chunks_used, so src/app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx renders no styled Sources block and the raw block shows as plaintext (live: /blog/state-of-the-atlas-the-spine-is-genealogy-the-surprise-is-the-tao).

CHANGE in src/app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx (server component): when post.chunks_used is empty, run parseCitationsBlock(post.content) (C1); render the returned body as the markdown prose, and if it yielded citations render them through the existing <Citation> 'Sources' section (same JSX as the chunks_used path, lines ~104-127). When chunks_used IS present, keep current behavior unchanged (LLM-generated posts already strip server-side and store structured sources).

CONSIDER: doing this at render keeps it robust for already-published manual posts (no backfill/migration needed). Alternatively parse-on-save in createManualDraft to populate chunks_used — note the tradeoff but prefer render-time to cover existing rows.

TEST: a manual post whose content ends in a CITATIONS block renders styled Sources cards and the raw block is stripped from the body. Depends on C1.
